name: savebar
need: Save or discard unsaved changes from a bar that appears when something changed, or keep a form's actions in reach

--ds-savebar-offset.description: save bar: distance from the view's bottom edge

--ds-savebar-inset.description: save bar: distance from the view's sides (the bar is at most `--ds-content-max` wide)

--ds-savebar-min-height.description: save bar: the base of its least height (size md, comfortable density)

--ds-savebar-bleed.description: `.ds-savebar--inline`: how far the bar runs beyond its form on both sides; set it to the inline padding of a container of the page's own

--ds-savebar-room.default: its least height at the largest size, `--ds-space-8`, `--ds-space-2` and the safe area
--ds-savebar-room.description: `.ds-savebar--inline`: the room its scroller and the snackbars keep clear of it; set it for a bar taller than two rows
